text_block_list.text:
A summer training camp to hone her skills. 
We want to ensure steady growth for the 
Kikuka Sho, but as for Seiun Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! I mean, it's a training 
camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A place both strict and kind, perfect for 
the growth of Umamusume—in other words—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The sea! Fishing! A chance to reel in fish 
I've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I brought an illustrated guide along, too~ 
You can catch some pretty good fish around 
here♪
choice_data_list: Let's give training our all, too!
Let's do our best with training too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding~ As if you didn't know☆ Don't 
worry, I'll train properly too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume gather at the training 
camp. It's the perfect opportunity to 
gather intel. And above all—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan and the others are here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, we still have plenty 
of time! Let's start with one—no, ten 
fish!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's a nice rocky spot over that way! 
Let's go scout it out♪

And so, our intense...? summer training 
camp with Seiun Sky began.
